audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer said 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer said Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie/Diana/Diana — and the packet itself flags that chart as contradicting a 47.97% win rate.
audit.why: Annie's real edge is levels 1-2, when Diana has no dash and must walk inside 625. From level 3 Lunar Rush (22s) exists and Pale Cascade shields the exact burst Annie opens with, so the middle and late rows belong to Diana — which is what a sub-50% win rate describes.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Annie/Annie/Skill/Diana/Diana/Diana/Diana in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings and whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly credits Diana's ULTIMATE with her dash and reset: 'her ult grants dash-reset potential', 'dive through minions with R', 'resets her ultimate off kills', 'Look for dive resets with R'.
audit.why: Riot text: Lunar Rush (E) is the dash, and it 'has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight' — that is the reset. Moonfall (R) reveals, draws in and slows at 475 range with a 100/90/80s cooldown and resets nothing. So her gap-close spike is level 3, not level 6; level 6 adds the pull, not the mobility.
audit.corrected: Every reference reassigned: Lunar Rush is the dash and the reset, Moonfall is the 475-range pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned Pale Cascade, the ability that decides whether Annie's burst kills.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'shield-absorbs-burst': Pale Cascade gives three orbiting spheres plus a shield that gets stronger if the third sphere detonates — it absorbs precisely the stun-into-W-Q window Annie's whole gameplan is built on. Its cooldown falls from 15s to 9s.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d, phases[3].why and spikes[3] now tell you to bait the spheres onto the wave before spending the stocked stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called a whiffed Crescent Strike a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Crescent Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 seconds. The genuinely long cooldown to punish is Lunar Rush at 22s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Eight-second window stated for the Q, 22s named for the dash.

edits.before: Hold the four-stack glow and watch him orbit at max range — a stocked Annie controls the lane by standing there.
edits.after: Pale Cascade absorbs the exact burst you open with — force the three spheres out first, then spend the stun.

edits.before: Tibbers online — Flash-R-W-Q deletes most mids from full health. The lane is now a geometry problem about your Flash range.
edits.after: Tibbers online, but so is Moonfall — her 475-range pull drags you back inside her, and your 130s bear only answers once.

edits.before: Luden's/Stormsurge spike: the stun-burst math kills through Doran's defenses. Stock, walk forward, win.
edits.after: Her free Lunar Rush outpaces your 130s ultimate — hold the glow for her dive, never for the wave.

edits.before: Late Annie flips fights with one button: flash-Tibbers the clump, peel with the bear, and re-stock off the chaos.
edits.after: She jumps your backline off a Moonlight mark; one button answers one dive, so save the bear to peel it.

edits.before: Diana wins by landing Crescent Strike, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Diana wins by marking you with Crescent Strike, riding the free Lunar Rush in, and shielding through your burst.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Molten Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Diana Crescent Strike: 8s at rank 1 — the Moonlight it leaves makes Lunar Rush cost no cooldown, so sidestep the arc and her 22s dash is her only entry. - Molten Shield is 10s; save it for the dash, not the poke. - Tibbers goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: If Diana opens the score, reset expectations and respect Crescent Strike doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Diana opens the score, never stand where the arc can clip you — one Moonlight mark makes her dash free. Farm with Q refunds under tower and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry the one button — Flash-Tibbers her the moment Pale Cascade pops, and peel your own backline with the bear.

edits.before: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, zone Diana off CS by existing, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.
edits.after: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, deny CS while her dash sits on 22s, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.

edits.before: Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Moonlight makes Lunar Rush free — sidestep the arc and her only entry is a 22s dash. Its cooldown is the green light.

edits.before: At four stacks: walk forward, Q-stun, W, auto, walk away re-stacking off the wave — a guaranteed chunk he answered with nothing.
edits.after: Pale Cascade's three spheres shield her through burst — bait them onto the wave, then stun into W-Q while it is down.

edits.before: Diana burns Crescent Strike on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Diana burns Crescent Strike on a minion — take the eight-second window.

edits.before: That’s Diana’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Unstacked, you eat Crescent Strike into Lunar Rush with no stun to answer.

edits.before: Level 3: Diana still lacks a reliable engage tool, so a whiffed Crescent leaves her exposed to Annie's full combo.
edits.after: Level 3: Lunar Rush unlocks a real gap-close, so trades hinge on whether Crescent Strike marks you before your stun.

edits.before: Levels 4-5: Annie's item-independent burst plus stun keeps outpacing Diana's still-limited kit before her ultimate unlocks.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favor Diana: Pale Cascade's shield eats the stun-burst, and Lunar Rush is down to 16 seconds for follow-up.

edits.before: Level 6: Annie's stun-Tibbers combo remains the faster kill threat the instant both champions hit their ultimates.
edits.after: Level 6 favors Diana: Moonfall drags you back in from 475 and Lunar Rush costs nothing onto any Moonlight target.

edits.before: First item favors Diana: her ultimate reset now lets her dash through minions and burst before Annie lands a second stun.
edits.after: First item favors Diana: Lunar Rush costs no cooldown onto a Moonlight target, so she bursts before Annie's stun re-arms.

edits.before: 2+ items favor Diana: she becomes a full pick/dive threat with resets that outscale Annie's single burst combo.
edits.after: 2+ items favor Diana: Moonfall pulls the clump, Pale Cascade shields the answer, and she outscales one burst combo.

edits.before: Diana's ult finally gives her a real gap-close and reset tool, closing the massive early gap Annie built — this is where the lane starts to even out.
edits.after: Moonfall pulls you in from 475 range and sets up her whole combo; the gap-close and the reset were always Lunar Rush, and at 6 both are online.

edits.before: With one item Diana can dive through minions with R and burst you down before you land a second stun, especially if Crescent lands first.
edits.after: With one item, a Crescent Strike mark makes Lunar Rush cost nothing — she dashes in and bursts you before your stun re-arms.

edits.before: Fully scaled, Diana becomes a pick-and-dive nightmare who can reset off multiple kills in one ult chain, well past what Annie's single burst combo answers.
edits.after: Fully scaled, Diana chains Lunar Rush from mark to mark through a fight and shields each burst with Pale Cascade, past what one Annie combo answers.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 heavily favor you: Diana has no reliable poke without landing a skillshot, and her melee range means she has to walk up into your Disintegrate and stun threat just to trade. From 3-5 keep punishing every missed Crescent Strike — she's committing to a bad spot on the map and your stun can end the fight before she gets a second cast off. Push the wave and consider roaming, since Diana lacks the tools to punish you for leaving before level 6.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 heavily favor you: Diana has no dash yet and no poke without landing a skillshot, so she must walk into your Disintegrate and stun threat to trade at all. From 3 Lunar Rush changes that — punish every missed Crescent Strike, because a whiffed mark leaves a 22-second dash as her only entry and your stun ends the fight first. Push the wave and roam in the levels before she has it.

edits.before: Level 6 is the turning point: her ult grants dash-reset potential that finally lets her close distance and threaten an all-in you can't easily disengage from. Keep your Pyromania stun charged for the moment she commits R at you, and don't get greedy extending trades once she has ult up — a landed Crescent into R can flip a fight fast. If you're ahead in gold, keep abusing her lack of early tools; if even, respect her all-in the instant she hits 6.
edits.after: Level 6 is the turning point: Moonfall drags you back to her from 475 and locks in an all-in you cannot walk out of. Keep Pyromania charged for the moment she commits, and don't extend trades once Moonfall is up — Crescent Strike into a free Lunar Rush into R flips a fight fast. If you're ahead in gold, keep abusing the levels before her dash; if even, respect the all-in the instant she hits 6.

edits.before: Diana scales into a genuine teamfight-deleting diver who resets her ultimate off kills and can jump straight to your backline through Tibbers or peel. Annie's one-combo burst is strong but single-target and has a real cooldown window Diana can punish once she's ahead; ward flanks and don't stand isolated near her jump range. If Annie fell behind in lane this matchup gets very hard late — the early advantage is where all of Annie's win equity lives.
edits.after: Diana scales into a teamfight-deleting diver who chains Lunar Rush between Moonlight marks and lands on your backline straight through Tibbers or peel. Annie's one-combo burst is strong but single-target, and a 130s ultimate is a window Diana punishes once ahead; ward flanks and never stand isolated inside 825. If Annie fell behind in lane this gets very hard late — the early levels are where Annie's win equity lives.

edits.before: Look for dive resets with R once ahead in items
edits.after: Chain Lunar Rush resets once ahead in items

notes: Largest correction of the slice: the content layer credited Diana's ultimate with the dash and the reset. Lunar Rush (E) is both; Moonfall (R) is a 475-range pull with no reset. That moved her gap-close spike from level 6 back to level 3 and is why the level chart was rebuilt rather than patched. Chart rows proposed in matched full/content pairs, atomic. Chart change is Medium confidence: it is inferred from the 47.97% win rate over 1011 games plus the packet's own defect note, not from a source that states stage-by-stage winners — if the run prefers the packet chart verbatim, revert the six side edits and the three win[] edits together, not individually.
